_about: Template based on a Next.js + AI-harness workflow project shape. Copy the kit with `gate init --with-kit`, then replace every path and glob with your own. See TEMPLATE.md.

structure.why: Code that cannot compile or that breaks the architecture cannot ship. Keep this gate strict.

data.why: Hardcoded credentials and missing i18n keys are production incidents, not style issues.

logic.why: Every functional point in the plan must be traceable in code; debug residue means unfinished work.

ui.why: Token discipline and basic accessibility. Looser than structure because UI debt is recoverable.

e2e.why: Starts lenient; raise it once real run results (inputs.e2eResults) are wired in.

architectureLayers.why: The library layer must not depend on routes; routes depend on the library.
Hooks are shared primitives; route components are not importable from them.
Shared components stay route-agnostic so they can be reused and tested in isolation.
